will_it_rain.name: Will It Rain? -- Weather Risk Prediction System
will_it_rain.tech: React, Leaflet, Chart.js, NASA POWER API
points: Developed a weather analytics platform leveraging NASA climate data for event-level risk prediction.
Integrated geospatial input with multi-parameter analysis across temperature, precipitation, wind, and humidity datasets.
Implemented interactive data visualizations to surface trend analysis and probability-based insights.
Enabled structured data export in CSV and JSON formats to support planning and operational decision-making.

smart_traffic.name: AI-Based Smart Traffic System Using Computer Vision
points: Designed and deployed a YOLOv8 object detection pipeline achieving 94% accuracy across varied traffic conditions.
Improved simulated intersection throughput by 25% through adaptive signal control algorithm development.
Implemented low-latency model inference for real-time edge deployment with sub-200ms scene analysis latency.

cert_generator.name: Certificate Generator and Verification System
points: Automated high-throughput certificate generation processing 1,000+ records per batch, reducing manual effort by 90%.
Implemented a QR-based credential verification system enabling instant, tamper-resistant certificate validation.
Built an interactive canvas editor with support for dynamic layouts and reusable template components.

irrigo.name: IRRIGO -- Smart Irrigation Platform
points: Developed an AI-assisted smart irrigation platform integrating satellite imagery and weather API data for precision scheduling.
Reduced agricultural water consumption by approximately 20% through data-driven analysis across 50+ farm scenarios.
Built a full-stack analytics dashboard for real-time environmental monitoring and agricultural telemetry visualization.

droidops.name: DroidOps -- Android Device Management GUI
points: Built a native Rust and Tauri desktop application for ADB management, improving process execution efficiency by 40%.
Applied Rust memory safety and concurrency primitives to implement reliable multi-device synchronization.
Delivered batch processing and optimized shell access features to streamline Android device lifecycle management.

glyphdeck.name: GlyphDeck -- Desktop Font Manager
points: Developed a high-performance Go application indexing 1,200+ fonts with sub-500ms search and retrieval latency.
Optimized binary size to a 25MB native executable using the Wails framework, minimizing system overhead.
Increased user productivity by 40% through efficient metadata parsing and optimized font search algorithms.
